events.title: The Stitchline Roadblock
events.description: A barricade of knotted bobbins and taut running-stitch cord stretches across the patchwork lane while hostile figures stir behind the cloth.

choices.text: Break through the stitched barricade (Fight)
Pay the road toll (spend 14 gold)
Turn back down the quiet seam (Leave)

events.title: The Frayed Bridge Watch
events.description: A swaying bridge of braided felt spans a dark ravine, where armed sentries block the crossing until thread or steel settles the right of way.

choices.text: Hold the frayed bridge by force (Fight)
Offer two thread bundles for safe passage (spend 2 scraps)
Retreat from the bridge crossing (Leave)

events.title: The Lanternless Ambush
events.description: Guttering wicks leave a velvet hollow in deep dusk as lurking shapes close around the unlit crossroads.

choices.text: Stand and face the closing shadows (Fight)
Buy a sealed lantern pass (spend 18 gold)
Slip back to the lit road (Leave)

events.title: The Knotted-Yarn Patrol
events.description: Tangled skeins of heavy wool snare the roadside posts while a roving patrol demands a tribute of yarn to clear the path.

choices.text: Cut the snares and confront the patrol (Fight)
Trade a spare yarn scrap to pass (spend 1 scrap)
Skirt the knotted wool (Leave)

events.title: The Buttonwall Checkpoint
events.description: A rampart of stacked brass buttons and heavy quilted shields seals the narrow pass against travellers without a stamped token.

choices.text: Challenge the buttonwall garrison (Fight)
Purchase a stamped gate token (spend 20 gold)
Step away from the checkpoint (Leave)

events.title: The Bellspool Picket
events.description: A chain of oversized brass bells and thread-wrapped spools blocks the moonlit lane; doll sentries turn as one when the bells ring.

choices.text: Ring the bellspool and face the sentries (Fight)
Pay the bell toll (spend 16 gold)
Retreat along the quiet seam (Leave)

events.title: The Scissor-Clock Tollhouse
events.description: A squat button-eyed tollkeeper shelters under a giant scissor-faced clock; its brass blades tick as stitched sentries bar the midnight lane.

choices.text: Cut the scissor-clock chain and confront the sentries (Fight)
Pay 17 gold for a stamped scissor-clock pass
Take the unlit side path (Leave)

events.title: The Mothglass Lantern Patrol
events.description: A plump moth puppet circles a huge glass lantern as candle-eyed guards block the velvet road with stretched silk wings.

choices.text: Scatter the moth-wing guards and fight through (Fight)
Offer 2 scrap bundles of wick thread for passage
Follow the dark path around the lantern (Leave)

events.title: The Crowpin Quilt Checkpoint
events.description: A button-eyed crow doll perches on an oversized silver safety pin above an oxblood quilt wall; masked guards wait beneath its wings.

choices.text: Raise the crowpin banner and challenge the guards (Fight)
Pay 13 gold for a crowpin crossing token
Turn away from the quilt wall (Leave)

events.title: The Button-Drum Masquerade
events.description: A brass-button drum booms beneath plum bunting; round masked ragdoll drummers raise patched shields to block the torchlit street.

choices.text: Challenge the button-drummers at the barricade (Fight)
Trade 3 scrap bundles for a guarded pass
Slip past the quiet bunting (Leave)
